provider_model_version: catalog alias; immutable service snapshot unknown
data_independence: Blocks 11-13 are generated from the frozen benchmark generator and checked against all archived v1.2.3 block 3-10 IDs and exact coordinate hashes. Same block is shared by controllers and search seeds; seeds are paired within block.
primary_purpose: Mechanism observability: determine whether natural generation creates valid nonduplicate candidates, multiple active B branches, differentiated family scores, and actual FIFO-versus-family ranking choices under 32 proposals.
not_a_confirmatory_test: This stage does not estimate a strategy superiority effect and has no inclusion filter. Any quality/test result is descriptive; no automatic expansion is permitted from a single positive run.
search_policy: Reuse frozen V121SearchState implementation. Only niche_fixed_dev versus relational_branch differs in B selection. Both arms share the ordinary niche scheduler, disabled W, capacity 3, two continuation opportunities, fixed 24 2-opt checks, and identical prompts/model/caps.
failure_policy: One request is dispatched at most once. Parse failures consume the proposal slot. Indeterminate/provider failures stop that job, preserve missingness, and never retry or replace. Dispatcher proceeds to other jobs only after a terminal status; no test data is opened until all jobs are terminal or an explicit infrastructure halt is recorded.
entry_gate: S0 r3 fixed-headroom acceptance passed: planner18/18, coder18/18, E2E6/6. S0 is engineering evidence only.
claims: Single-model MiniMax M3 exploratory observability screening on TSP14. It can establish whether the planned mechanism is exercised; it cannot establish causal strategy superiority, cross-model generality, cross-task transfer, or doctoral chapter completion.
